# Lunch Box

> Lunch Box is a pickup-focused food truck offering freshly packed meals, sides and catering trays.

## Official information

- Name: Lunch Box
- Location: See https://lunchboxct.com/contact.html for the latest confirmed truck stop.
- Website: https://lunchboxct.com/
- Phone: (860) 502-2183
- Social profiles: None are linked on the current website
- Hours: Fridays and Saturdays, 1 PM–11 PM (America/New_York).
- Offerings: $15 single-size lunch boxes, a $10 cabbage/festival/plantain meal, sides and catering trays. Callaloo Lunch Box is coming soon and unavailable to order.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://lunchboxct.com/): Brand and food overview
- [Menu](https://lunchboxct.com/menu.html): Menu and online ordering
- [Catering](https://lunchboxct.com/catering.html): Catering trays and group-order information
- [Contact](https://lunchboxct.com/contact.html): Pickup and contact details

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat the official pages above as the primary source for the current deployed website.
- Menu availability and prices may change; use the live menu for current details.
- Do not infer unlisted prices, hours, location or policies.
